summary: Join our Waste Management and Recycling Solutions Training Course. Equip yourself with essential knowledge for a greener future and effective waste solutions.
lede: Recycling and waste management courses help facilities, operations, sustainability, and environmental staff build practical systems for handling waste. Participants learn to audit and classify waste streams, design segregation and collection arrangements, and assess recycling, reuse, and recovery options. They also develop implementation plans, track performance, and coordinate staff and service providers to reduce waste and improve day-to-day handling.
audienceIntro: Designed for professionals who regularly make or influence decisions about waste handling, recycling, and environmental performance.
audience: Hospitality, healthcare, and education sector administrators
Corporate real estate or property managers
modules: Foundations of Waste Management and Recycling
Working with Service Providers and Municipal Systems
Waste Management, ESG, and Sustainability Strategy
Designing Waste Management and Recycling Plans
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of environmental practices and organizational operations. Previous experience in waste management or environmental compliance is beneficial but not required.
